Spheres

Activating Spheres

Each character is now able to use spheres to activate certain effects.

You can check the spheres you currently have on the Activate Spheres screen by selecting Activated Spheres from a character's Gear/Abilities screen.


Activated Effects

Sphere slots vary by character.
Two slots are unlocked to start.

Each slot may only accept and activate spheres of its corresponding letter.
Eg., only A spheres may be used in an A slot.
　
Additionally, a sphere that has activated its effect will be consumed.


Overwriting Spheres

A different sphere may be used to overwrite an active effect.
In that event, the overwritten effect will be lost.

Removing Spheres

You can use a Reset Stone to remove activated spheres.
Removed spheres return to your inventory and can be activated again later.

Obtaining Spheres

There are bonus spheres, acquired from realized gear, and refined spheres, acquired from refining.

• Obtaining Bonus Spheres

Bonus spheres may be obtained by performing a limit break on a realized weapon three times, and raising the weapon to its maximum level.

You can check what bonus sphere may be obtained by viewing Realization on the details window for weapons that have had realization unlocked, or by simply viewing the details of a weapon that has been realized.

• Obtaining Refined Spheres

Refined spheres may be obtained by refining sphere fragments along with high shards and high crystals.

You can obtain sphere fragments by completing certain co-op quests of LV 150 or above.
If you can obtain sphere fragments, will be displayed.

The type of spheres you can refine differ by event.

Each event's sphere refinery will remain available for three days after the event ends.

If an event drops sphere fragments, they may be refined from that event's screen, or by selecting Refine from the Enhancements screen.


Unlocking Sphere Slots

Some sphere slots begin locked.

A locked slot may be unlocked by performing a limit break on realized armor three times, and raising the armor to its maximum level.

You can check what sphere slot may be unlocked by viewing Realization on the details window for armor that has had realization unlocked, or by simply viewing the details of armor that has been realized.
